# Isaan Isan Resort Khaoyai

> Boutique resort 300 metres from the entrance to Khao Yai National Park, in Moo Si, Pak Chong, Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand. Your gateway to Khao Yai and to Isan culture: a lobby shaped like a kratip (sticky-rice basket), pha khao ma weaves throughout, and the rooster as its emblem. 82 rooms across 4 room types. Bilingual site (English / ไทย).

Website: https://isaan-isan.com

## Rooms
82 rooms in total: Superior 50, Deluxe 14, Grand Deluxe 9, Pool House Villa 9.
Rates change with the season; see the booking engine or contact the resort for current prices.

- Superior King (25 rooms) — 32 m², king bed, private balcony, garden view.
- Superior Twin (25 rooms) — 32 m², twin beds, private balcony, garden view.
- Deluxe King (7 rooms) — 35 m², king bed, private balcony, garden view.
- Deluxe Twin (7 rooms) — 35 m², twin beds, private balcony, garden view.
- Grand Deluxe King (4 rooms) — 40 m², king bed, mountain stream view, private wooden soaking tub on the balcony.
- Grand Deluxe Twin (5 rooms) — 40 m², twin beds, mountain stream view, private wooden soaking tub on the balcony.
- Pool House Villa (9 villas) — 40 m² standalone private pool villa in the gardens, 1 or 2 bedrooms.

Check-in from 14:00, check-out until 12:00. Reception open 24 hours, daily.

## Dining
- Isaan Isan Restaurant — authentic Isan cuisine from local ingredients; 84 seats, indoor and outdoor.
- Menu (Isaan Baan Hao): https://isaan-isan.com/menu

## Spa
- Isaan Sumbai Spa (อีสานซำบาย) — Thai, aromatherapy oil, herbal compress and hot stone massage, body scrub. Treatments from ฿800 (60 min); packages from ฿2,000. Prices include VAT 7% and 10% service charge.
- Spa menu and packages: https://isaan-isan.com/spa
- Spa bookings: +66 (44) 011 888

## Experiences & Facilities
- Open-air cinema nights on a canvas screen in the resort grounds
- Isan night-market evenings with craft stalls and traditional games
- Outdoor swimming pool with a kids' pool
- Concierge, tour desk, laundry, meeting room, EV charging, free Wi-Fi throughout
